newsitem.title: USA: Medjet can begin eye waterjet trials.
newsitem.headline: Medjet can begin eye waterjet trials.

text.p: Medjet Inc said Thursday that it had been notified by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration that the agency has determined that the company's HydroBrush Keratome is a non-significant safety risk device and that, therefore, no prior approval by the FDA is required before the company begins clinical trials to demonstrate ease of use.
The device, the first using a high-speed waterjet for corneal surgery, is designed to remove the epithelial, or outermost, layer of the cornea.
According to Medjet, the procedure is typically performed with a knife blade in a scraper mode, which often slightly damages the underlying Bowman's layer.
